propositions: When close-gate verification exhausts its search budget without refuting any criterion (insufficiency-only FAIL), the gate should automatically re-run the verification instead of requiring operator intervention
The auto-resumption loop must reuse the existing _insufficiency_only predicate to qualify failures; only FAILs where all unmet criteria carry evidence_sufficient:false trigger a resume

Resumptions are bounded by verify.auto_resume_max config (default 2, minimum 0 to disable) and by progress: a resumption dispatches only when the prior attempt strictly increased the cache-credited PASS count
The resumption uses the same ref binding as the original close and seeds the verdict cache with credited PASSes from the prior attempt, concentrating the fresh budget on remaining criteria

Per-attempt trail (attempt number, cache-credited count, remaining unmet count) is recorded to the verdict sidecar and visible in close output; if exhausted after bounded resumptions, the failure surfaces with the resumption count
